## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 87 captures during January 2024. Activity was carried out as scheduled, with session lists managed in the usual way. The available records indicate that routine leave was the only operational variation noted during the month. There were no other issues identified in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 10 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 11.5. The finding should continue to be monitored through routine review of image acquisition and session practice. Where appropriate, feedback from grading can support staff in maintaining consistent image quality and reducing the number of ungradable submissions.

## Grading

A total of 13 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 4. This provides a summary measure of turnaround during January 2024 and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings. Overall, the site maintained planned operations, while the ungradable results and referable grading outcomes remain the main points for ongoing operational review.
